sources.title: vinguyen0891/Vivy-R-Vision-3B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The native Rust engine (vivy-r-core + vivy-decide) receives the ArrangementCriteriaSpec and solves global lighting, camera lens, perspective projection, Socket-Lock kinematic constraints, and Catmull-Rom temporal splines across up to 30 Shot Blocks (180.0s / 3 minutes at 24 FPS = 4,320 frames) with zero LLM tokens generated during frame synthesis.
